metin: Ago varsa Perfect yok.
Altı dakikada Simple Past'in kuralını, zaman belirteçlerini ve sınav tuzaklarını bitiriyoruz.
A finished action at a definite time in the past.
Birinci kök.
Marie Curie won her second Nobel Prize in 1911, three years before the war began.
In 1911 belirli zaman, yani Simple Past. Won ve began düzensiz.
Tuzak: begin, began, begun. Burada begun yanlış.
İkinci kök.
We used to live in a village, and we would walk to school every morning.
Used to durumu da alışkanlığı da anlatır.
Would yalnız tekrarlanan eylemde olur: would walk doğru, would live yanlış.
Üçüncü kök, asıl tuzak.
The manager resigned two weeks ago, and the board has not found a replacement yet.
Resigned: ago var, zaman belli, Simple Past.
Has not found: yet var, zaman belirsiz, Present Perfect.
Hocam, ago varken has resigned yazsam olmaz mıydı?
Olmaz.
A definite time word blocks the present perfect.
Ago, last year, in 1911: belirli zaman. Present Perfect for, since, yet ister.
Did not resign.
Kod: ago varsa Past, since varsa Perfect.
